item.title: AI Native Infrastructure
item.description:
About This Book

This handbook provides a comprehensive guide to building and operating AI-native infrastructure. It covers the full stack from hardware scheduling to application runtime design, with a focus on production-ready implementations.

Who This Book Is For

  • Platform engineers building internal ML platforms
  • Infrastructure architects designing AI systems at scale
  • Technical leaders evaluating AI infrastructure investments
  • DevOps engineers extending cloud-native skills to AI workloads

What You’ll Learn

Part 1: Foundations
